description: Implement Astral Mage and The Sorcerer's Ziggurat as distinct Phaser 4 sentence cartridges using reusable target-action and isometric-step families, with dual editions, QC coverage, typed host proofs, and safe catalog cutover.
deviation_notes: Both zero-implementation games were rebuilt directly on Phaser 4 APK families. Review added swept projectile collision, visible duplicate-token equivalence, tween-safe touch queuing, and real 390x844 completion coverage. Product-owner QC was approved on 2026-07-10.

sprint.goal: Turn the two unfinished sentence placeholders into distinctive, package-consumable Phaser games without changing the educational input or result contracts.
sprint.demo_notes: Use Advantage Games `/qc?cartridge=astral-mage` and `/qc?cartridge=sorcerer-ziggurat`; verify Primary Chibi and Secondary Epic, keyboard/touch completion, exact result rendering, and clean relaunch.
